notes: *out* was assigned to the preposition rather than read as a phrasal particle of *cast*, since מִפָּנָיו is what the ASV renders *out of his sight*; the ASV writes a rendering for each morpheme, so rule 2 splits rather than rule 30 fusing.
עַד אֲשֶׁר fuses to *until* headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23).
